children: shares jumped 9% in London trading on Tuesday after the B&Q and Screwfix owner raised its FY profit guidance following stronger first-half results.

Adjusted pre-tax profit rose 9.9% to £404M in the six months ended July 31, while underlying like-for-like sales increased 0.3%. Screwfix was the standout performer, with like-for-like sales up 5.6%, helping offset weaker trading at B&Q.
raised its FY2026/27 adjusted pre-tax profit guidance to £595M-£635M, from £565M-£625M previously. It also lifted free-cash-flow guidance to £480M-£520M from £450M-£510M.
The company said higher gross margins, cost savings, and stronger Screwfix trading supported the upgrade. B&Q's second-quarter like-for-like sales fell 1.8%, with big-ticket sales down 8.1%.
maintained its interim dividend at 3.8 pence per share and said it would begin the third £50M tranche of its £300M share-buyback programme this week.

title: Kingfisher climbs after raising FY profit guidance
